name: Cherre
insight: Founded in 2016 by L.D. Salmanson; has raised about $105M from backers including Intel Capital and Nuveen.
tagline: Real estate data platform for building AI agents on your connected data.
description: Cherre is a real estate data management and intelligence platform that unifies fragmented internal and external data into a Universal Data Model and knowledge graph. Its 2025 Agent.STUDIO product lets firms build and deploy model-agnostic AI agents and pre-built 'Work Packages' for tasks like underwriting, tenant risk scoring, and variance analysis. It targets asset and investment managers, with enterprise contact-sales pricing.

modelSupport.notes: Model-agnostic — clients pick and switch between AI providers for their agents.

edge: Runs agents on a real-estate-specific Universal Data Model and knowledge graph of 3.3B+ addresses, not generic LLM retrieval.
pros: SOC 2; data not used for training
cons: Enterprise contact-sales only, no public pricing
Built for asset/investment managers, not solo agents
Value hinges on connecting your data sources
